script_text: Stop! Aries, this Neptune opposition exposes the gap beneath your confidence. The Sun in Libra opposes Neptune in Aries, activating your 1st and 7th Houses of identity and partnerships. Mars, Aries' Fire-sign ruler, moves through Cancer and squares Saturn in Aries between your 4th and 1st Houses, turning domestic pressure into a test of authority and boundaries. If single, this 7th-House alignment can attract an imaginative, expressive partner whose romantic gestures feel exciting; check whether their actions consistently match promises. If taken, avoid filling silence with fantasy and ask directly what your partner needs. For career and money, Venus's square to Uranus between the 6th and 3rd Houses can turn one client email or contract into a sudden negotiation; read the terms twice before replying. Avoid borrowing against tomorrow to assert independence; Mars-Saturn rewards financial discipline. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
